description: Election Commission - Mr. S.D.I Ruwan was selected as the member of the Mahara Pradeshiya Sabha - Mr. S.M Sabry was selected as the member of Kattankudy Urban Council - Mr. M.U Salma was selected as the member of Kattankudy Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Mahara Pradeshiya Sabha and Kattankudy Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes, specifically the replacement of elected members who have resigned or ceased to be party members, which falls under election-related matters rather than central government personnel or structural changes.
